column3: Between materials science and quantum transport: new materials and heterostructures for quantum electronics.
In-situ deposition of semi- and superconducting nanoscale patterns, and crystal-growth modelling for selective-area growth of III-V heterostructures.
Silicon T-centres for single-photon generation and quantum memory: design, fabrication and optical measurements (PhD).
AMO physics and quantum optics: ultracold atoms, ultrastable lasers, optical frequency standards and atomic clocks with strontium and magnesium.
